author: Arnav
problem: Read N, A and the arrival times T_1 < ... < T_N of N people at a ticket counter. Each purchase takes A seconds and people are served one at a time in arrival order. Print, on separate lines, the time each person finishes.
bug_description: When the counter is free it sets the finish time to arrival + A - previous finish instead of arrival + A.

comments.accurate: Starts each purchase at the later of the arrival time and the previous finish, then adds A
comments.wrong_behavior: When the counter is idle, a purchase finishes A seconds after arrival, minus the time the counter already ran
comments.wrong_location: Idle-counter case verified; check a waiting customer's purchase adds A to the previous finish
